text:
maya (product): quick sync — we need a crisp acceptance checklist for enterprise compliance work (audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2/ISO readiness, retention lanes). customers are asking for specifics.
kevin (eng): +1. main constraints: retention export size, indexing cost, and BYOK handshake latency. will need rollout plan by tier. :thumbsup:
jenna (security): add: KMS attestation, rotation window, and proof of deletion for keys. SOC2 evidence needs deterministic audit export format.
omar (sales): two large prospects (FinCo, AcmeBank) require BYOK + 7y retention option. they want timeline and what we can guarantee in contract.
erin (custeng): for pilot, AcmeBank wants: 1) BYOK with HSM attestation, 2) searchable audit-export for 90 days, 3) retention toggle per-tenant. they can accept phased deliverables.
maya (product): propose split: Phase A (MVP): BYOK handshake + 90d audit-export + retention presets; Phase B: long-term retention buckets (1y, 7y), immutable export, legal-hold API. thoughts?
kevin (eng): Phase A doable if we scope BYOK to KMS-on-cloud (no on-prem HSM attestation). Phase B requires archive infra and index-migration plan. performance note: continuous batching interacts with retention retrieval latency.
jenna (security): can't sign off without HSM attestation for FinCo. we should offer 'attestation-as-a-service' via partner or escalate for higher tier. also need threat model update.
sara (legal): contract language: don't promise 'absolute deletion' without specifying retention windows + escrow. need specific SLOs for export time and proof formats.
omar (sales): we can trade timeline for premium fee. customers prefer written acceptance tests. can we draft those now?
maya (product): sketch of acceptance tests: 1) BYOK handshake: ingest customer key, verify KMS handshake logs, rotate key -> system still decrypts archived evidence when authorized. 2) Audit export: produce NDJSON export with schema X, include chain-of-custody headers. 3) Retention toggles: set tenant retention=7y, perform delete API after TTL -> verify tombstone + export snapshot.
erin (custeng): add scenario: can we produce a sampled audit export within 15m for 90d retention? customer expects fast search on recent logs.
kevin (eng): implement retention tiers with cold-archive background jobs. 15m sample for 90d feasible with hot index; 7y will be cold and paginated. need cost estimate.
jenna (security): also need regression suite: run synthetic prompts -> verify that audit entries contain request-id, model-version, route, tenant-id, and KMS key-id.
audit-bot: new ticket created: COMPLIANCE-7621 "Audit export schema + BYOK acceptance tests" assigned to eng/security/product.
sara (legal): draft acceptance clause: delivery = passing acceptance tests in staging + audit export sample for legal review. include rollback window and SLO credits.
maya (product): next steps: kevin + jenna to produce tech spec + test harness by EOW, sara to draft contract language, omar to prioritize prospects for pilot, erin to coordinate AcmeBank pilot.
omar (sales): pinging AcmeBank for kickoff Tues. :calendar:
kevin (eng): will document API shape for: POST /v1/keystore/handshake, GET /v1/audit/export?start&end&tenant, POST /v1/tenant/{id}/retention -> include example payloads.
jenna (security): I'll add KMS attestation checklist and HSM partner options to the spec.
maya (product): thanks all — capturing these notes into the roadmap ticket. quick ask: keep scope tight for Phase A. we can iterate on archival indexing later. :eyes:
